title: Ensure pam_unix does not include nullok
description: Verifies that the pam_unix.so module in the active PAM configuration's system-auth and password-auth files does not contain the nullok argument without the without-nullok placeholder.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Hostname or IP of the target Linux server.

playbook_output.description: Audit result: whether the system is compliant and list of any violations found.

fields.name: compliant
fields.description: True if no nullok violations were found, false otherwise.

fields.name: violations
fields.description: List of violation objects, each containing 'file' (system-auth or password-auth) and 'line' (the full matched line).

steps.name: Read authselect.conf
steps.function: Retrieve the contents of /etc/authselect/authselect.conf to obtain the active profile name.

steps.name: Extract profile and compute PAM directory
steps.function: Decode the authselect.conf content, extract the first line as the profile name, and determine the base directory for PAM files based on the profile type.

computations._pam_dir: Set to '/etc/authselect/{{ _profile }}/' if _profile starts with 'custom/', otherwise '/etc/pam.d/'.

steps.name: Read system-auth file
steps.function: Retrieve the contents of the system-auth file from the appropriate PAM directory.

steps.name: Read password-auth file
steps.function: Retrieve the contents of the password-auth file from the appropriate PAM directory.

steps.name: Parse files and find nullok violations
steps.function: Decode both file contents, then search each line for occurrences of 'pam_unix.so' containing 'nullok' but NOT containing the placeholder '{if not "without-nullok":nullok}'. Assemble a list of violation objects.

computations._violations: From the decoded lines of system-auth and password-auth, find every line that contains 'pam_unix.so' and 'nullok' but does not contain '{if not "without-nullok":nullok}'. For each such line, record an object with 'file' set to 'system-auth' or 'password-auth' and 'line' set to the full line text.
computations._compliant: True if the _violations list is empty, false otherwise.

steps.name: Emit compliance result
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block containing the overall compliance status and the list of detected violations.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Read authselect.conf and determine the active PAM directory.

phases.name: Data collection
phases.description: Read the system-auth and password-auth files from the correct location.

phases.name: Analysis
phases.description: Parse the file contents and identify nullok violations.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
